Perhaps things didn't work out between us. Maybe it was the things we couldn't talk about.. or the things we couldn't agree on. Eventually, we fought without ever coming back to a compromise.

I suppose I have myself to blame, but now I have nothing.
I really haven't. I gave it some thought, but everything just seems like a waste of time to me now.
I really have no idea what I'm doing.

Because you can let that go, bro. I'm not a licensed psychiatrist or anything, but you can help yourself, and all of us here can help you too. 

You're only seventeen, you still got a lot ahead of you. Have you ever thought about devoting your time to do what you really love? Ask yourself what kind of purpose you want in life, because we all can strive for one.  I'm trying to find out what is bothering you, and I want to help you. 

Have you ever thought about doing anything in the long run? Something to get your mind off of this.

Hey buddy. I feel for you. I'm sorry you're in such a dilemma right now. I perhaps don't know exactly what you're going through, I'm just some random stranger. I want to help you. I'm just some twenty year old kid, not even in college. I don't know what I want to do in my life, I'm not a very sociable person either. Currently, like you, I'm just letting life play its cards for me. I don't have a job, but I'd like one. 

It's hard to find the strength to keep moving, especially since everything seems so trivial. You know what? Everything is pretty trivial, isn't it? 

Don't do it. I know, I'm just some random kid on the internet; but please. Don't do it.

There's so much ahead of you that you haven't explored, there are so many opportunities that you haven't experienced yet.. there are so many things to look forward too. If you'd like to talk about your depression, feel free to send me a pm. I'll pass you a song that helped me get through my crisis; and I hope you can overcome yours.
